posts.author: Mirang_Shah
posts.text: As of today, Transrail has approval to raise up to ₹600 crore through QIP, but the final issue price will be determined when the QIP is launched.

posts.author: Yashovardhan
posts.text: Any idea on the issue price for the QIP? Has that data been released?

posts.author: Mirang_Shah
posts.text: This stock nosedived. Breaking it’s 52 week lows aswell but upon digging, I am unable to find any concrete reason. Seems planned 600 Cr capital raise via QIP is one of the reason but still such fall is pretty unexpected.
